subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the security CODEOWNER approve this grouped set of new action SHAs for workflows that consume repository tokens, app private keys, registry credentials, and code-scanning permissions?
rationale: The reviewed releases and immutable pins show no concrete defect, but repository policy and CODEOWNERS reserve approval of these credential-bearing workflow dependencies for the security owner, and the direct Codex-source gate remains incomplete.

options.title: Approve after final proof
options.body: Approve the grouped update after the direct Codex source check and current exact-head workflow matrix complete successfully.

options.title: Split sensitive action bumps
options.body: Separate Codex, token, publishing, and CodeQL action updates if the security owner wants narrower review or rollback boundaries.

options.title: Pause the batch
options.body: Hold the PR if a specific upstream behavior change cannot be validated against the affected workflow.

recommendation.title: Approve after final proof
recommendation.body: Approve the grouped update after the direct Codex source check and current exact-head workflow matrix complete successfully.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly assigns this team to multiple security-sensitive workflows changed by the PR.
